content.value: Root words provide the fundamental core meaning of words. For example, -bene- means good, -mal- means bad, and -chron- means time.
परीक्षा टिप्स: सेतु श्रृंखला के मुख्य सूत्रों और बिंदुओं को बार-बार दोहराएं।

mcqs.question: What does the root word -bene- mean?
mcqs.explanation: -bene- comes from Latin meaning well or good.
